sharedRules.name: Combo Attack
sharedRules.description: If the Attack is successful then after resolving a Damage Roll, deduct 2 from the Success Level of the Attack. If the new Success Level is 0 or greater make another Damage Roll against the Defender. Repeat this process until the Success Level is less than 0. If the Success Level of the original attack was 0 or 1, after resolving a Damage Roll, make one additional Damage Roll against the Defender at Success Level 0.

sharedRules.name: Counterstrike Defence
sharedRules.description: If this Defence is successful, and the Attacker allocated any dice to Attack, then deduct 2 from the Success Level of the Defence. If the Success Level is 0 or greater, then make a Damage Roll against the Attacker using the modified Success Level of the Defence.

sharedRules.name: Sidestep Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, the Attacker leaves BtB and then moves away from the Defender until the Attacker leaves The Defender's ZoC, at which point its movement ends.
The Attacker makes no damage roll.

sharedRules.name: Sidestep Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, the Defender leaves BtB and then moves away from the Attacker until the Defender leaves The Attacker's ZoC, at which point its movement ends.

sharedRules.name: Critical Attack
sharedRules.description: If this model’s Attack is successful, and the individual dice results of the Damage Roll are the same number, remove the Defender from play.

sharedRules.name: Drag Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, move the Attacker 1” away from the Defender, then move the Defender 1” directly toward the Attacker.
The Defender does not suffer a Damage Roll from this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Forceback Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, move the Defender 1” directly away from the Attacker, then move the Attacker 1” directly towards the Defender.
The Defender suffers half the wounds from the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Grapple Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the attack is successful, the Defender becomes Held. Place a Held marker on the Defender.
The Defender does not suffer a Damage roll from this Attack but may not attack during this Melee Exchange.

sharedRules.name: Powerful Attack
sharedRules.description: If the Attack is successful, then the Attacker gains +3 to the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Push Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, move the Defender directly away from this model until it leaves this model’s ZoC.
The Defender does not suffer a Damage Roll from this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Slam Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, the Defender is moved 3” directly away from the Attacker and becomes prone.
The Defender suffers half the wounds from the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Stun Attack
sharedRules.description: If the attack is Successful, the Defender gains a Stunned Marker after the Damage Roll.

sharedRules.name: Sweep Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, then the Defender becomes Prone.
The Defender suffers half the wounds from the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Throw Attack
sharedRules.description:
If the Attack is successful, the Defender is moved 2” away from the Attacker in a straight line and becomes prone.
The Defender suffers half the wounds from the Damage Roll caused by this Attack.

sharedRules.name: Ivory Prison Attack
sharedRules.description: If this Attack is successful then remove the non- Insignificant, non-Soulless Target from play and deploy a Prone, non-unique Kairai under your control by replacing the target

sharedRules.name: Gokusatsu Attack
sharedRules.description:
If this attack is Successful, remove the defender and attacker from play.
If the enemy model has this Exceptional Attack, then this attack has no effect on either combatant.

sharedRules.name: Drag Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, move the Defender 1” away from the Attacker, then move the Attacker directly into BtB with the Defender.

sharedRules.name: Forceback Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, move the Attacker 1” directly away from the Defender, then move the Defender directly into BtB with the Attacker.

sharedRules.name: Push Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, move the Attacker directly away from the Defender until it leaves the defender’s ZoC.

sharedRules.name: Sweep Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, then the Attacker becomes Prone.

sharedRules.name: Throw Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, the Attacker is moved 2” away from the Defender in a straight line and becomes prone.

sharedRules.name: Eagle's Flight Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful this model may Move 3" after the Melee Exchange is resolved.

sharedRules.name: Grapple Defence
sharedRules.description: If the Defence is successful, the Attacker becomes Held. Place a Held marker on the Attacker.

sharedRules.name: Dual Attack
sharedRules.description: If the Attack is Successful, after rolling Damage, make one more Damage roll at the same Success Level.

sharedRules.name: Web Defence
sharedRules.description: If this model successfully Defends, the Enemy model may not move until the current activation has ended.

sharedRules.name: Kageshoku Attack
sharedRules.description: If the attack is successful, after the Melee Exchange is completed, Place this model within 2".
